children: Indonesia's finance minister on Friday said he is committed to the legislated annual fiscal deficit cap of 3% of GDP, and called for discussion about any potential changes to fiscal rules to be done in a constructive manner.

Suahasil Nazara said this was so that financial markets do not react to the news in a way that disrupts Indonesia's fiscal management. He was responding to a question about parliament's discussion about potential changes to the fiscal deficit and debt ceiling.
